description: Situated in the residential area of Middlesbrough, Langdale Crescent offers convenient access to local amenities and transport links, making it an ideal choice for tenants seeking a well-connected location. The property is positioned within close proximity to several schools, including Bankfields Primary School and Eston Park Academy, providing excellent educational options for families. For healthcare needs, the Langridge Medical Centre is nearby, ensuring easy access to medical services. Residents will also benefit from the nearby Eston Leisure Centre, which offers fitness facilities and recreational activities. The property is well-served by public transport, with bus routes connecting to Middlesbrough town centre and surrounding areas, while the A66 and A174 provide excellent road links for commuters. Nature enthusiasts will appreciate the proximity to Flatts Lane Woodland Country Park, offering scenic walking trails and green spaces for outdoor activities. This property combines practicality with access to local amenities, making it a desirable rental opportunity.
